scope: Clause15 source-level acceptance map for the existing container editor; not universal normative conformance or whole-schema completion.

requirements.inspected_behavior: Version4 inputs only; serialization copies the original eight-byte header.
requirements.qualification: Only inherited source keys are supported. There is no new-key constructor or independent Annex-B key/signature validation in this path.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Local/central records retain parsed source signatures; the end signature comes from the parsed directory.
requirements.qualification: Valid native source signatures are preserved; this is not a new-container construction proof.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: archive_position subtracts eight with checked u32 conversion; central offsets are rewritten after physical-order emission.
requirements.qualification: Independent corpus/editor evidence is scoped to its recorded fixtures.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Local and central name bytes are copied together from headers already checked for equality.
requirements.qualification: Names are preserved; this path does not add or rename streams.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Changed payloads are deflated with flags6/method8 and recalculated CRC/lengths; version-needed20 is required on input.
requirements.qualification: The parser accepts stored method0 and nonzero per-entry extra/comment areas. Untouched headers/payloads are preserved. Canonical writer conformance for all such permissive inputs is not established.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.qualification: Permitted omission is supported; filler generation is not implemented.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: No new filler or decoys are generated by edited serialization.
requirements.qualification: No-op serialization returns the original source bytes rather than revalidating all random filler.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Entries are sorted by source local-record position before both local and central emission. Original internal attributes are retained.
requirements.qualification: The writer does not infer or repair an XML attribute bit missing from its source.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Local and central date/time fields are retained from the source headers.
requirements.qualification: No release-derived timestamps or new-document timestamp policy is provided.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

requirements.inspected_behavior: Unchanged entries copy their exact original stored ranges; equivalent/reverted replacements clear the pending edit.
requirements.qualification: Logical meaning, application reload/save and unrelated unsupported carriers remain separate checks.
requirements.status: Inspected with bounded existing evidence; not globally closed

remaining: All permissive-input writer canonicalization policies and independent expected results
